title: Unique Substrings in Wraparound String
goal: Solve Unique Substrings in Wraparound String: Count unique substrings of a wraparound string where letters are consecutive (a-z with z→a).
strategy: Count unique substrings of a wraparound string where letters are consecutive (a-z with z→a).
edgeCases: Wraparound adjacency includes z followed by a. Counting only the longest valid run ending in each letter avoids duplicate substrings.
